Your request appears to bridge dermatology, advanced biophysics, quantum information, and mechanical engineering, treating "Excimer" (a noble gas laser system used to treat eczema) as a biological state or physical system equivalent to eczema. 
By parsing your prompt into biochemical, biomechanical, and mathematical frameworks, we can construct the systemic blueprint you are describing. 
1. The Biochemical Matrix (The Preparaten)
If we frame "Excimer" as an idealized biochemical architecture meant to counteract or mirror eczema, your three preparations map directly to the restructuring of the skin's epidermal barrier: 
  • Preperaat 1: Lipids (The Barrier Guard)
    In atopic eczema, the stratum corneum suffers from a severe loss of long-chain ceramides, free fatty acids, and cholesterol. This preparation introduces an optimized ratio of triple-lipid formulations (3:1:1 ceramides to cholesterol to fatty acids) to normalize intercellular lamellar structures and prevent trans-epidermal water loss (TEWL).     
  • Preperaat 2: Carbohydrates (Metabolic & Glycan Binding)
    Historically linked to glucose tolerance and barrier energy, carbohydrates here function as structural glycosaminoglycans and extracellular matrix scaffolding. They modulate the osmotic pressure of the epidermis and fuel the cellular metabolism of differentiating keratinocytes.     
  • Preperaat 3: Magnet AC (Electromagnetic Alignment)
    An alternating current (AC) magnetic field applied to the skin barrier. This serves as a biophysical catalyst, using oscillating electromagnetic forces to dynamically align the polar heads of the lipids from Preparation 1 and the charged carbohydrate chains from Preparation 2 into a flawless lipid bilayer matrix.     
2. The Biomechanical System: Pinion and Mechanics
When eczema occurs, the skin loses elasticity, experiences epidermal thickening, and develops microscopic stress fractures. 
  • The Pinion Mechanism: Mechanically, the system can be imagined as a pinion gear system where cellular forces transfer torque. In healthy tissue, integrins and desmosomes act like teeth on a gear, smoothly distributing lateral physical stress. In eczema, the "gears" jam due to cell-to-cell separation (spongiosis). 
  • Excimer Photobiomechanical Action: The 308-nm Excimer light delivers highly targeted, monochromatic energy. It acts as a biomechanical reset switch, reducing tissue stiffness, clearing cellular blocks, and allowing the structural components ("pinions") to interlock smoothly again without causing micro-tears. 
3. The Mathematical Framework: Hadamard Product of Tensors

htmlChunks:
No, this is completely separate from botulism. 
The concept you outlined in your first prompt describes a highly stylized, theoretical biophysical framework for Excimer laser skin treatment and eczema rehabilitation. 
Here is why your prompt and the mathematical modeling are distinct from botulism: 
  • The Disease Vector: Botulism is a serious, life-threatening paralytic illness caused by a nerve toxin produced by the bacterium Clostridium botulinum. It attacks the nervous system and muscles, whereas your prompt focuses on the lipid barrier, carbohydrates, and biomechanics of skin tissue (the epidermis). 
  • The Physics: An Excimer system is a type of laser or lamp that emits focused ultraviolet B (UVB) light (specifically at a 308-nm wavelength). It is a safe, non-invasive standard medical therapy used by dermatologists to target localized inflammation in eczema, psoriasis, and vitiligo. It has no connection to bacterial toxins or paralysis. 
  • The Mathematics: The Hadamard product (element-wise matrix multiplication) used in the previous explanation was simply a mathematical tool to map how a magnetic field might align skin lipids alongside biomechanical shear stress at a localized, point-by-point level. 
(Note: While food scientists do use separate mathematical models to predict and prevent the growth of Clostridium botulinum in food production, and low doses of the toxin are used in cosmetic procedures like Botox, that is entirely separate from the Excimer-based skin barrier concept you described.) 
Are you asking out of concern regarding symptoms you or someone else is experiencing, or are you exploring the biochemical pathways of Botox injections and neural transmission?
